dataset.truth: provided neighbors (10,000 x 100 int32); event uses the first 10 neighbors

implementation.note: mirrors E4 registered build config at 100K (e4_preregister.py); variation therefore attributable to seed x order, not thread scheduling

order_definitions.lid_ascending_by_norm: rows sorted ascending by L2 norm of the vector (deterministic proxy for intrinsic-dimension ordering; seed-independent)

identity_check_builds.purpose: byte-identity replay of one build config at 1M scale (contract check)

query_roles.sampling: numpy RandomState(991).choice(10000, 500, replace=False) over the test split
query_roles.disjointness: query vs base raw-content SHA256 overlap must be 0; evaluated BEFORE risk computation
query_roles.forbidden: no other test queries are searched; the remaining 9500 stay sealed

event_semantics.quality: hit_count >= 10 of 10 at Recall@10 (returned top-10 contains all of the provided true top-10)
event_semantics.min_safe_action: B(q) = min ef in grid with hit_count >= 10; BOT if none
event_semantics.tie_handling: none needed (float distances, ties measure-zero; recorded if seen)

metrics_preregistered: finite-action variation; endpoint variation; inclusive variation
incremental transport risk (mean over all 8x7 directed pairs; reference = target bottom rate)
max-over-source pooling k-curve for k in 1..7 (50 random draws per k, seed 991)
profiling cost: 59-query resident search (8 threads) + cold load + exact-truth timing
D1-style contract identity: two identical-config builds must have equal index SHA256 and equal search outputs
storage_protocol: indexes are deleted after search results and SHA256 are recorded (disk budget 15GB); only CSV results, hashes and logs are retained
stop_rules: if query/base overlap > 0 or any build errors, halt and record; no grid change after first search
analysis_blinding: risk/variation computed only after all 8 builds complete
